subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should fallback verification prove individual fallback-model reachability, the real ordered fallback runner, or both through one unified diagnostic surface?
rationale: The semantics and public contract differ materially: independent probes are safer, while production-chain execution better represents real failover but introduces state and error-handling complexity.

options.title: Unified isolated diagnostics
options.body: Provide both configured-model and ordered-fallback scopes through one non-mutating probe service shared by the CLI and any slash-command presentation.

options.title: Reachability only
options.body: Probe each configured fallback independently and document that this does not validate production fallback ordering.

options.title: Production chain only
options.body: Exercise the real fallback runner in a dedicated diagnostic context and accept the additional state-isolation and reporting requirements.

recommendation.title: Unified isolated diagnostics
recommendation.body: Provide both configured-model and ordered-fallback scopes through one non-mutating probe service shared by the CLI and any slash-command presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history across fallback policy, model status probing, and the existing issue-level review.
